Hi Jonas,

Congrats on closing with Alto — really excited to collaborate. Quick ask from our comms team: Alto's standard procurement docs permit press acknowledgement but require a 45-day embargo for any co-branded press. We noticed Redwood's Order Form references a broader publicity clause and an "orderform publicity" checkbox that was left as TBD.

Two small requests so we can plan our joint announcement:
- Can Redwood accept a 45-day quiet period before any public mention or feature callouts?
- Alto needs a narrow logo use license limited to press materials and one customer quote, with the option to approve the exact quote and logo treatment.

We can sign a short publicity addendum or accept your standard publicity evidence flow (we have to provide a logo bundle and SOC-2 evidence). If possible, can you confirm what evidence Redwood requires and whether an escrow/asset stamping is acceptable?

We have the signed Order Form (attached) but the publicity language was left for legal. Happy to hop on a 20-min call if helpful.

Thanks,

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2029 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Press acknowledgement & publicity exception — Alto deployment

Thanks for the context, Jonas. I had a quick pass and drafted proposed language — see notes below and attached 'proposed_publicity_redlines.docx'. High-level summary:

1) Quiet period: Acceptable to grant a 45-calendar-day embargo post-production go-live OR post mutual announcement date (we recommend clarifying which trigger Alto prefers). We will add: "Customer may request a 45-calendar-day embargo on public announcement; Redwood will comply provided Redwood receives written notice at least 5 business days prior to planned publication."

2) Logo use: Limit license to use of customer logos on Redwood marketing materials, press releases, and case studies with Alto's prior written approval for each placement. Add a good-faith review clause with a 5-business-day approval turnaround. Include a prohibition on modifying Alto's logo without express consent.

3) Quote & attribution: Redwood may use up to two customer quotes (max 250 characters each) unless customer provides an approved quote. All quotes will be sent to the customer for approval where practicable; if the customer doesn't respond within 5 business days, Redwood may proceed with a neutral paraphrase.

4) Evidence / escrow: We can accept logo assets and a link to SOC-2 summary, but we will not take custody of a customer's SOC-2 report. Instead: (a) customer provides a confirmation statement that SOC-2 is in scope and a public link to the SOC-2 summary or auditor letter; (b) assets will be stored in Redwood's asset repo (alto_logos.zip attached) for the life of the case study.

5) Opt-out carveout: Add a one-time exception path for customers who require embargoes >45 days — escalatable to Legal + GTM for review.

I flagged three items that need product/sales confirmation: (a) whether we can delay release if there is product-dependent timing, (b) whether marketing needs any longer lead time for press coordination, and (c) whether we should require a signed publicity addendum for any testimonial use.

I'll attach the redlines and a short addendum template. If you want, I'll send this version directly to Elena as a proposed one-page addendum.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_publicity_redlines.docx
